"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Household surveys show that hundreds of thousands of new jobs have been created through self-employment and by small businesses, unreported.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Homeownership rates are at record levels – seven out of ten American families own their own home today.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Consumer confidence is up from the levels seen at this time last year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Inflation remains low by historical standards.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Mortgage rates remain low by historical standards.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"The success is attributed to the hard work of the American people and the Republican commitment to low taxes.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Support for preventing taxes on families from going up next year.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Support for making the tax relief of the last four years permanent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Support for reforming the tax code to make it simpler, fairer, and more growth-oriented.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
